latest.description: latest is the latest version compatible with the cluster. It is left out when EKS publishes none.

incomplete.description: incomplete is true when the add-on or its latest version could not be read.

AddonSkew.description: AddonSkew is the version of one add-on against its latest compatible version.

name.description: name identifies the item. For a Region failure it is the region.

cluster.description: cluster is the cluster that the item belongs to.

operation.description: operation is the IAM action that failed, such as "eks:DescribeNodegroup".

retryable.description: retryable reports whether the same command, run again with no other change, may succeed.

error.description: error is one line of text for people. Do not parse it; use Reason.

awsErrorCode.description: awsErrorCode is the AWS API error code, such as AccessDeniedException, when AWS answered.

updateId.description: updateId is the EKS update ID, for a failure of a started update.

Failure.description: Failure is one item that refresh could not read, or one action that it tried and that did not complete.

FailureKind.description: FailureKind is the type of item a Failure is about.

Failures.description: Failures is the failure list of a document. A nil list encodes as [], so a document always has its failures key as a list.

HealthOutcome.description: HealthOutcome is what a health check found.

blocking.description: blocking is true when a Fail of this check blocks a change.

message.description: message is one line about what the check found.

findings.description: findings name the things behind a Warn or a Fail, such as the nodes that are not ready.

HealthResult.description: HealthResult is the result of one health check.

status.description: status is the EKS value: PASSING, WARNING, ERROR, or UNKNOWN.

kubernetesVersion.description: kubernetesVersion is the version that the insight is about.

Insight.description: Insight is one EKS cluster insight.

minorsBehind.description: minorsBehind is how many minor versions the nodegroup trails the control plane.

atSkewLimit.description: atSkewLimit is true when the nodegroup is at the kubelet skew limit: the next upgrade of the control plane would put it past it.

incomplete.description: incomplete is true when the nodegroup could not be read.

NodegroupSkew.description: NodegroupSkew is the version of one nodegroup against the control plane.

Readiness.description: Readiness is the verdict of "refresh cluster upgrade-check".

upgradedAt.description: upgradedAt is when the upgrade to the current version started. EKS counts the window from when it finished, so the dates are approximate.

insights.description: insights counts the ROLLBACK_READINESS insights by status. It is left out when they could not be read.

Rollback.description: Rollback says that the cluster can roll back to its previous minor version, and until when.

controlPlaneVersion.description: controlPlaneVersion is the Kubernetes minor version of the cluster.

Skew.description: Skew is the version skew of a cluster: its nodegroups against the control plane, and its add-ons against their latest compatible version.

daysRemaining.description: daysRemaining is the days until the tier ends, with a part of a day as a whole day. It is left out when no window is open.

autoUpgrade.description: autoUpgrade is true when the upgrade policy of the cluster is STANDARD: EKS upgrades it at the end of standard support, and it never enters extended support.

builtIn.description: builtIn is true when the dates are the ones that refresh ships with, because EKS did not report them.

Support.description: Support is the support window of the Kubernetes version of a cluster.

SupportTier.description: SupportTier is where the Kubernetes version of a cluster is in its EKS support window.

apiVersion.description: The version of the document contract.

version.description: version is the Kubernetes minor version of the control plane.

reasons.description: reasons are the findings behind the readiness, worst first.

insights.description: insights are the EKS cluster insights of the category, as --status and --show-passing filter them.

insightsEvaluated.description: insightsEvaluated is false when EKS returned no insight of the category at all, passing ones included: it has not evaluated the cluster yet. It is left out when the insights could not be read.

checks.description: checks are the readiness checks: the insights, the version skew, and the control plane.

failures.description: Every failure of the run: the items that refresh could not read and the actions that did not complete. The list is sorted by kind, region, cluster, name, and operation. It is [] when there are no failures.

title: UpgradeCheck
description: The document that `refresh cluster upgrade-check -o json` prints. -o yaml prints the same structure.
